column1: # The JVM suites the acceptance gate runs. ONE source of truth, read by both
# run-bump-gate.sh (to build its gradle task list) and record-gate-counts.py (to decide which
# results on disk are the gate's).
# Why this file exists rather than a list in each place:
# record-gate-counts.py used to take "every module with results on disk" as the gate's set. That is
# a different set from "every module the gate ran", and the difference is silent in both directions.
# Running an ungated suite by hand left its XML in the shared build directory, and the next record
# picked it up and then failed the gate on a module the gate never runs -- an auditor hit exactly
# that. The reverse is worse: a module dropped from the gate's task list keeps its stale results on
# disk and keeps being counted, so the ledger goes on asserting a suite that no longer runs.
# With one list, the two cannot disagree: a module here is run AND counted, and a listed module with
# no results is an error rather than a silent zero.
# car-apps-common, car-assist-lib and plugin were added 2026-08-18. They had 52 green tests between
# them and were in neither the gate's task list nor the ledger.
